toefl:se:27.answer: For students, this can mean completing readings or assignments before classes begin.
toefl:se:27.fullSentence: For students, this can mean completing readings or assignments before classes begin.
toefl:se:27.japanese: 学生にとって、これは授業が始まる前に読書課題や宿題を終わらせることを意味する場合があります。
toefl:se:27.explanation: this can meanで「これは〜を意味しうる」と具体化する表現。
toefl:se:27.relatedInfo: finish homework early / get ahead on assignments

toefl:se:28.answer: However, I think Andrew's argument about routines is more convincing overall.
toefl:se:28.fullSentence: However, I think Andrew's argument about routines is more convincing overall.
toefl:se:28.japanese: しかし、私は全体としてルーティンについてのアンドリューの主張の方がより説得力があると思います。
toefl:se:28.explanation: overallは「全体として」と文全体を修飾する副詞。
toefl:se:28.relatedInfo: more persuasive / makes a stronger case

toefl:se:29.answer: Productivity depends more on consistency and energy level than on the specific time of day.
toefl:se:29.fullSentence: Productivity depends more on consistency and energy level than on the specific time of day.
toefl:se:29.japanese: 生産性は特定の時間帯よりも、一貫性やエネルギーレベルに大きく左右されます。
toefl:se:29.explanation: depend more on A than on Bで「BよりAに左右される」という比較表現。
toefl:se:29.relatedInfo: is more affected by / hinges more on

toefl:se:30.answer: Some people are naturally more focused at night; forcing them to wake up early can reduce their sleep, which actually harms concentration and memory.
toefl:se:30.fullSentence: Some people are naturally more focused at night; forcing them to wake up early can reduce their sleep, which actually harms concentration and memory.
keyPhrases: forcing them to wake up early
toefl:se:30.japanese: 中には夜の方が自然と集中できる人もおり、そうした人に早起きを強いると睡眠が減り、実際には集中力や記憶力を損なうことになります。
toefl:se:30.explanation: セミコロンで関連する2つの文を1文にまとめている。

toefl:se:31.answer: For these people, a well-planned evening schedule might be much more effective than a tired early-morning routine.
toefl:se:31.fullSentence: For these people, a well-planned evening schedule might be much more effective than a tired early-morning routine.
toefl:se:31.japanese: そのような人にとっては、疲れた状態での早朝ルーティンよりも、よく計画された夜のスケジュールの方がはるかに効果的かもしれません。
toefl:se:31.explanation: much more effective thanで差を強調する比較級。
toefl:se:31.relatedInfo: a carefully structured night routine / a well-organized evening plan

toefl:se:32.answer: In my view, the best approach is to find the time of day when you can focus most deeply and then create a stable routine around that period, whether it is early morning, afternoon, or late at night.
toefl:se:32.fullSentence: In my view, the best approach is to find the time of day when you can focus most deeply and then create a stable routine around that period, whether it is early morning, afternoon, or late at night.
toefl:se:32.japanese: 私の考えでは、最も深く集中できる時間帯を見つけ、それが早朝であれ午後であれ夜遅くであれ、その時間帯を中心に安定したルーティンを作ることが最善のアプローチです。
toefl:se:32.explanation: whether A, B, or Cで「AであれBであれCであれ」と選択肢を並列する。
toefl:se:32.relatedInfo: identify your peak focus time / find your most productive hours

toefl:se:33.answer: In my opinion, it's a good idea to wake up early to be more productive.
toefl:se:33.fullSentence: In my opinion, it's a good idea to wake up early to be more productive.
keyPhrases: good idea to wake up early
toefl:se:33.japanese: 私の意見では、生産性を高めるために早起きをするのは良い考えです。
toefl:se:33.explanation: to be more productiveは目的を表す不定詞句。
toefl:se:33.relatedInfo: it makes sense to / it's beneficial to

toefl:se:34.answer: First, waking up early helps us live a healthier lifestyle.
toefl:se:34.fullSentence: First, waking up early helps us live a healthier lifestyle.
toefl:se:34.japanese: まず、早起きは私たちがより健康的な生活を送るのに役立ちます。
toefl:se:34.explanation: help 人 doで「人が〜するのを助ける」という表現。
toefl:se:34.relatedInfo: contributes to a healthier life / promotes healthy habits

toefl:se:35.answer: For example, getting up with the sunrise allows us to enjoy natural sunlight, which studies say can improve our mood and make us feel more energetic.
toefl:se:35.fullSentence: For example, getting up with the sunrise allows us to enjoy natural sunlight, which studies say can improve our mood and make us feel more energetic.
toefl:se:35.japanese: 例えば、日の出とともに起きることで自然な日光を浴びることができ、研究によればそれは気分を改善し、より活力を感じさせてくれます。
toefl:se:35.explanation: which studies sayは挿入的に「研究によれば」と根拠を示す。
toefl:se:35.relatedInfo: boost our mood / lift our spirits

toefl:se:36.answer: Also, people who wake up early have more time to establish a daily routine, such as exercising, studying, or eating a healthy breakfast.
toefl:se:36.fullSentence: Also, people who wake up early have more time to establish a daily routine, such as exercising, studying, or eating a healthy breakfast.
keyPhrases: more time to establish a daily routine
toefl:se:36.japanese: また、早起きする人は、運動や勉強、健康的な朝食を取るといった日課を確立する時間をより多く持てます。
toefl:se:36.explanation: such as A, B, or Cで具体例を列挙している。
toefl:se:36.relatedInfo: build a daily habit / set up a morning routine

toefl:se:37.answer: Having this regular routine can help us stay organized and get more done throughout the day.
toefl:se:37.fullSentence: Having this regular routine can help us stay organized and get more done throughout the day.
keyPhrases: get more done throughout the day
toefl:se:37.japanese: この規則的な習慣を持つことで、私たちは物事を整理された状態に保ち、一日を通してより多くのことを成し遂げられます。
toefl:se:37.explanation: 動名詞Havingが主語になる文構造。
toefl:se:37.relatedInfo: keep things in order / accomplish more each day

toefl:se:38.answer: For these reasons, I believe waking up early can make us both healthier and more productive.
toefl:se:38.fullSentence: For these reasons, I believe waking up early can make us both healthier and more productive.
toefl:se:38.japanese: これらの理由から、早起きは私たちをより健康的で生産的にすると私は考えます。
toefl:se:38.explanation: both A and Bで「AとBの両方」と並列する。
toefl:se:38.relatedInfo: for these reasons / that is why

toefl:se:39.answer: I believe movie theaters do have a future, but they will become more specialized and experience-focused.
toefl:se:39.fullSentence: I believe movie theaters do have a future, but they will become more specialized and experience-focused.
toefl:se:39.japanese: 映画館には確かに未来があると思いますが、より専門的で体験重視のものになっていくでしょう。
toefl:se:39.explanation: do haveのdoは動詞を強調する強調用法。
toefl:se:39.relatedInfo: still have a future / remain relevant

toefl:se:40.answer: First, there are certain types of films that are simply better in a cinema.
toefl:se:40.fullSentence: First, there are certain types of films that are simply better in a cinema.
toefl:se:40.japanese: まず、映画館で見た方が単純に優れているタイプの映画があります。
toefl:se:40.explanation: that以下はfilmsを修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:40.relatedInfo: are best watched in theaters / are made for the big screen

toefl:se:41.answer: Large-scale action movies or visually stunning science-fiction films are designed for big screens and powerful sound systems.
toefl:se:41.fullSentence: Large-scale action movies or visually stunning science-fiction films are designed for big screens and powerful sound systems.
keyPhrases: big screens and powerful sound systems
toefl:se:41.japanese: 大規模なアクション映画や視覚的に見事なSF映画は、大画面と強力な音響システム向けに作られています。
toefl:se:41.explanation: be designed forで「〜向けに設計されている」を表す。
toefl:se:41.relatedInfo: built for the theater experience / made for large screens

toefl:se:42.answer: Watching them on a phone or laptop cannot create the same level of immersion, no matter how good home technology becomes.
toefl:se:42.fullSentence: Watching them on a phone or laptop cannot create the same level of immersion, no matter how good home technology becomes.
keyPhrases: cannot create the same level of immersion
toefl:se:42.japanese: たとえ家庭用技術がどれほど進歩しても、スマートフォンやノートパソコンでそれらを見ても同じレベルの没入感は生まれません。
toefl:se:42.explanation: no matter how+形容詞で「どれほど〜でも」という譲歩を表す。
toefl:se:42.relatedInfo: can't match the immersive feel / falls short of theater immersion

toefl:se:43.answer: Second, going to the movies is a social event.
toefl:se:43.fullSentence: Second, going to the movies is a social event.
toefl:se:43.japanese: 第二に、映画に行くことは社会的なイベントです。
toefl:se:43.explanation: 動名詞句going to the moviesが主語。
toefl:se:43.relatedInfo: a shared experience / a social occasion

toefl:se:44.answer: Meeting friends, sharing reactions in real time, and laughing or gasping with a room full of strangers creates a unique atmosphere that streaming at home cannot fully replace.
toefl:se:44.fullSentence: Meeting friends, sharing reactions in real time, and laughing or gasping with a room full of strangers creates a unique atmosphere that streaming at home cannot fully replace.
keyPhrases: streaming at home cannot fully replace
toefl:se:44.japanese: 友人と会い、その場で反応を共有し、見知らぬ人でいっぱいの部屋で一緒に笑ったり驚いたりすることは、自宅での配信視聴では完全には代えられない独特の雰囲気を生み出します。
toefl:se:44.explanation: 3つの動名詞句が並列して主語になっている。
toefl:se:44.relatedInfo: can't be fully replicated at home / no substitute for the theater

toefl:se:45.answer: This social element can motivate people to leave their homes even when it is less convenient or more expensive.
toefl:se:45.fullSentence: This social element can motivate people to leave their homes even when it is less convenient or more expensive.
keyPhrases: motivate people to leave their homes
toefl:se:45.japanese: この社会的な要素は、たとえ不便であったり費用がかかったりしても、人々を家から出るよう促すことがあります。
toefl:se:45.explanation: even whenは「たとえ〜な時でも」という譲歩の接続詞。
toefl:se:45.relatedInfo: drive people out of the house / encourage people to go out

toefl:se:46.answer: However, I agree with Paul that theaters must adapt.
toefl:se:46.fullSentence: However, I agree with Paul that theaters must adapt.
toefl:se:46.japanese: しかし、映画館は変化に適応しなければならないというポールの意見には賛成です。
toefl:se:46.explanation: agree with 人 that節で「〜という人の意見に賛成」を表す。
toefl:se:46.relatedInfo: need to evolve / must change with the times

toefl:se:47.answer: Offering reclining seats, high-quality food, themed events, or even live discussions with directors can make the experience feel special and worth the higher cost that Claire mentions.
toefl:se:47.fullSentence: Offering reclining seats, high-quality food, themed events, or even live discussions with directors can make the experience feel special and worth the higher cost that Claire mentions.
toefl:se:47.japanese: リクライニングシートや質の高い食事、テーマ性のあるイベント、さらには監督とのライブトークを提供することで、体験を特別なものにし、クレアが言及する高い料金にも見合うものにできます。
toefl:se:47.explanation: worth+名詞で「〜に見合う価値がある」を表す。
toefl:se:47.relatedInfo: justify the higher price / be worth the extra cost

toefl:se:48.answer: Therefore, cinemas may become fewer and more expensive, but they will survive as places that offer a premium, communal movie-going experience.
toefl:se:48.fullSentence: Therefore, cinemas may become fewer and more expensive, but they will survive as places that offer a premium, communal movie-going experience.
toefl:se:48.japanese: したがって、映画館は数が減り値段が上がるかもしれませんが、プレミアムで共同体的な映画鑑賞体験を提供する場所として生き残るでしょう。
toefl:se:48.explanation: survive asで「〜として生き残る」を表す。
toefl:se:48.relatedInfo: continue to exist / remain in business

toefl:se:49.answer: In my opinion, movie theaters can survive in the near future for several reasons.
toefl:se:49.fullSentence: In my opinion, movie theaters can survive in the near future for several reasons.
keyPhrases: can survive in the near future
toefl:se:49.japanese: 私の意見では、映画館はいくつかの理由から近い将来も存続できます。
toefl:se:49.explanation: for several reasonsは「いくつかの理由から」と後続の理由列挙を予告する。
toefl:se:49.relatedInfo: will continue to exist / are here to stay

toefl:se:50.answer: Firstly, movies have developed advanced visual and sound technologies that are best experienced in a theater setting.
toefl:se:50.fullSentence: Firstly, movies have developed advanced visual and sound technologies that are best experienced in a theater setting.
toefl:se:50.japanese: まず、映画は劇場という環境で最もよく体験できる高度な映像・音響技術を発展させてきました。
toefl:se:50.explanation: be best experienced inで「〜で最もよく体験できる」を表す。

toefl:se:51.answer: While some people think watching films on digital devices at home is the same, the large screen, surround sound, and shared atmosphere of a cinema cannot be fully replicated.
toefl:se:51.fullSentence: While some people think watching films on digital devices at home is the same, the large screen, surround sound, and shared atmosphere of a cinema cannot be fully replicated.
toefl:se:51.japanese: 家でデジタル機器を使って映画を見るのも同じだと考える人もいますが、映画館の大画面やサラウンド音響、共有される雰囲気は完全には再現できません。
toefl:se:51.explanation: Whileは「〜だが」という対比の接続詞。
toefl:se:51.relatedInfo: can't be recreated at home / is impossible to reproduce
